entries.zh: 主宰：掌管、支配（权柄、权威）；亦指主宰者
entries.en: to leave/relinquish authority; to hold dominion, sovereign control

entries.zh: 出祖：义难确指；读音同「出租」，或为让出、租与他人之义
entries.en: to relinquish power or authority (ut supra); Chinese collocate likely 'to let out / lease'
entries.notes: 「出祖」非常用词，依对音疑即「出租」，与西语词头（让渡权柄）的对应存疑。

entries.zh: 抛舍（原作「潘捨」，「潘」疑作「拋」）：抛弃、舍弃
entries.en: to leave it, give it up / cast it away
entries.notes: [疑] 「潘」疑作「拋」（拋捨＝抛弃），与西语 dejarlo 契合；mostrar dello 一节语义未定。

entries.zh: 放子：放走幼崽、放开雏子（母鸡纵雏、野兔产育自便）
entries.en: to let go the young; to let the hen [rear] her chicks, let the hare raise its young

entries.zh: 避位：让出位子、退避其位（辞让官位）
entries.en: to leave one's place or dignity; to vacate office, step aside

entries.zh: 避邪：躲避邪祟、驱邪避凶
entries.en: to shun evil, ward off evil influences
entries.notes: [疑] 西语词头 ystacia/ydeja 难辨，与「避邪」的对应未定；汉字栏与对音明确。

entries.zh: 弃工他往：放下手头的活计、赶往别处（原作「棎工郎」，字难确读）
entries.en: to leave off what one is doing in order to go attend to another place
entries.notes: [疑] 「棎」疑作「探」，字面难通，按西语释义（弃工他往）释义。

entries.zh: 继传（原作「繼傳」）：传给后人、留作遗产
entries.en: to leave an inheritance, bequeath

entries.zh: 弃官：辞官、放弃官职
entries.en: to leave one's office, resign a post

entries.zh: 传位：移交职位、传位于人
entries.en: to leave one's office; to hand over the post

entries.zh: 不根究伊：不追究他、放过他（不加责罚）
entries.en: to let him be and not punish him; to let him off without investigating

entries.zh: 放纵：放纵、任其自便（随他意所欲）
entries.en: to leave to one's own discretion; to let loose, indulge

entries.zh: 赦下：赦免释放、饶恕放开
entries.en: to leave, release, let go; to pardon and set free

entries.zh: 留名声（原作「留名聲」）：留下名声、身后留名
entries.en: to leave behind fame, a name and reputation
entries.notes: [疑] 首字疑晋/留，官话与闽南对音均读如「留」，故按「留名声」释义。

entries.zh: 致仕：辞官退休（官员自请离职归居）
entries.en: to leave office at one's own will; to retire from office

entries.zh: 传后（原作「傳后」）：传给后人、传诸后世
entries.en: to leave to posterity, to those who come after
entries.notes: [疑] 仅官话对音 hēū/hēn 之别，汉字「傳后」与词义明确。

entries.zh: 传后代（原作「傳后代」）：传给子孙后代
entries.en: to leave to descendants, posterity
entries.notes: [疑] 仅对音字（cey/tēy）之别，汉字「傳后代」与词义明确。

entries.zh: 传子及孙（原作「傳子及孫」）：传给儿子和孙辈
entries.en: to leave to sons and grandsons

entries.zh: 让畔（原作「讓畔」）：让出田畔、互让耕界（相让田界以睦邻）
entries.en: to yield him the field boundaries; to leave him the sowing grounds
entries.notes: 闽南栏 T99（污损难辨），西语词头（por todo por fiar）语序残乱，释义以汉字「讓畔」古典义（虞芮让畔）为准。

entries.zh: 息事：了结事情、平息争端（就此作罢）
entries.en: to let it end; to let the matter rest, be finished

entries.zh: 拠伊：随他去、任凭他（任其自便；原字难确读）
entries.en: to leave him to his own will; to let him be
entries.notes: [疑] 「拠」疑作「捉」，字难确读，按西语释义（任其自便）释义。

entries.zh: 在人：随人便、听凭其人（由人自定）
entries.en: to leave to one's will; it is up to the person

entries.zh: 任伊：任凭他、随他意
entries.en: to let him do as he pleases; to leave to his will
